wild-star.endgamePolicy: Final wild plus regular completes only when it is the last playable pair; another playable tile prevents completion.
wild-star.transactionPolicy: Shared immutable special transaction serializes commit and releases before terminal modal ownership.
wild-star.savePolicy: Core and registry identity round-trip through the versioned save schema; stale variant identity is rejected.
wild-star.inputPolicy: Input gate blocks unsafe special ownership and releases ordinary input only at the declared gameplay-safe boundary.
wild-star.audioPolicy: Variant-specific cue owner uses the shared decoded engine, eligibility warmup, Settings gate and registered full stop.

wild-juice.mergeOwner: app-core.ts Juice committed merge and spawn path
wild-juice.endgamePolicy: Final Juice plus regular completes only as the last playable pair; live blockers and active transactions defer terminal resolution.
wild-juice.transactionPolicy: Shared immutable special transaction owns board commit, visual-tail handoff and exact-token release.
wild-juice.savePolicy: Core and registry identity round-trip through the versioned save schema; incompatible variant/core pairs fail validation.
wild-juice.inputPolicy: Input unlock follows the declared Juice gameplay-safe ratio while the transaction continues to protect endgame.
wild-juice.audioPolicy: Variant-specific cue owner uses the shared decoded engine, eligibility warmup, Settings gate and registered full stop.

wild-magnet.mergeOwner: app-core.ts and app-merge.ts Magnet pull transaction
wild-magnet.endgamePolicy: Playable pull candidates prevent final completion; post-pull resolution rechecks the current board revision before complete or fail.
wild-magnet.transactionPolicy: Immutable Magnet token survives pull/merge work, rejects stale post-commit tails and releases on every rollback or terminal handoff.
wild-magnet.savePolicy: Core and registry identity plus restored live tiles are validated before gameplay resumes.
wild-magnet.inputPolicy: Special input remains locked through gameplay resolution; stable ordinary merges may resume only after board commit.
wild-magnet.audioPolicy: Variant-specific cue owner uses the shared decoded engine, eligibility warmup, Settings gate and registered full stop.

wild-tnt.mergeOwner: app-core.ts TNT impact and bonus-target transaction
wild-tnt.endgamePolicy: Terminal resolution waits for exact bonus-target reservation and gameplay settlement; visual tail cannot create an early clean or fail.
wild-tnt.transactionPolicy: Immutable TNT token marks board commit before ordinary merges resume and remains authoritative through bonus gameplay settlement.
wild-tnt.savePolicy: Core and registry identity round-trip through the versioned save schema and restored variants keep TNT semantics.
wild-tnt.inputPolicy: Special input releases only after gameplay-safe settlement; finale duration cannot substitute for the transaction boundary.
wild-tnt.audioPolicy: Variant-specific cue owner uses the shared decoded engine, eligibility warmup, Settings gate and registered full stop.
